title: Tech Stocks Dump, Bitcoin FOLLOWS: The Exact Downside Targets
speaker: Nick Valdez

macro_themes.view: Tech earnings sell-off and an AI cybersecurity scare pulled down the Nasdaq and Bitcoin with it.
Biggest Bitcoin ETF inflow since September ($528M) was not enough to offset the selling.
Favors tokens with fee-funded buybacks (ZRO, HYPE, PUMP) for buy pressure.
